author: cli
text: Re-read 2026-08-17. The version-gated extraction comments are exact: tar.extractall runs with filter='data' where the stdlib supports it (3.12+) and falls back to the pre-validated member list with the noqa marker below, so 'members are already validated and mode-normalized; pass the stdlib filter too for belt and braces' describes both branches truthfully. 'Derived is replaced; authored is merged' still matches DERIVED_DIRS and _merge_meta. The injectable fetch is still what makes the whole path testable without network - the file:// bundle validation in the 0.55.1 acceptance ran through exactly that seam.
